description: Hand-verified English-edition status for a stratified random sample drawn from international-awards.staging.json (seed 20260731). Each verdict required evidence of an actual English publisher/ISBN, not a translated title.

automationFailed: Google Books API: HTTP 429 from this network without an API key; unusable for bulk.
OpenLibrary: only viable query is 'English works by this author in a plausible year window'. Measured precision ~20% on a 30-entry trial (1 true positive: Friedlaender). Unusable.
Wikidata: only 221 of the 711 entries exist as items at all, and exactly 1 has an English edition modelled via P629+P407. No translation coverage for this material.
methodNotes.falsePositiveTrap: Rights-marketing catalogues (NORLA, Books From Poland, New Books in German, deutscher-sachbuchpreis.de/en) publish English TITLES for untranslated books. Four sampled books had an English title circulating with no English edition behind it. Any future resolver must require a publisher or ISBN.
methodNotes.falseNegativeRate: Non-trivial. Hedi Fried's book was published in English by Scribe but did not surface on the first query; found only on a second, English-title-first search. Treat every rate below as a FLOOR.
